snippet.title: We, Junk Artists - Official Release Window Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Release Window Trailer for We, Junk Artists, a casual multiplayer party game developed by Perfect Day Studio. Players will collage ordinary objects to create abstract masterpieces and guess each other's creations. Unleash pure imagination in We, Junk Artists, launching in August 2026 for PC (Steam).
